head: SEE_GIT_LOG

requirements.what_changed: gates/originality.py provenance_findings refuses an authored='brambleloop' CIR with no Provenance (PROVENANCE_MISSING), an incomplete one (PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE: concept_key, brief_digest, primitives_used, generated_by) or a non-Brambleloop author (PROVENANCE_NOT_OURS). certify() calls originality.release_findings once in the originality stage. Provenance backfilled on every catalogue builder (products/builder.py, nordic_forest.py, texture.py x3, vessels.py x2; garments already stamped by GradedDesign) and on creative/prototype.author non-garment CIRs. No design, count or text changed.
requirements.remaining: runtime/pipeline.concept_to_cir (cluster C) builds raw-geometry CIRs with no Provenance; certify now refuses them. C must stamp originality.catalogue_provenance there (or retire that path).

requirements.what_changed: Certification now requires complete design provenance, a passing design-difference ledger when benchmarks were consulted, and a clean similarity review against both purchased benchmarks.
requirements.remaining: certify does not read licence state (teardown/licence) for licensed inputs, because certify has no db and no product has licensed inputs today. next_action: give certify an optional db (cluster C, handle_certify passes ctx.db) and have originality refuse a provenance naming a licensed source whose licence lacks 'adapt_pattern_for_sale'.

requirements.what_changed: New table benchmark_licences (BenchmarkLicence: source_ref, source_kind, terms_source, allowed_uses, prohibited_uses, attribution, finished_item_rights, pattern_rights, notes). teardown/licence.py: validated Licence model, conservative default, KNOWN_LICENCES (benchmark 2's personal-use terms from VISUAL_BENCH2 s1; benchmark 1 conservative). Captured at teardown/intake.receive (never overwrites hand-recorded terms); library.retrieve(db=, use=) refuses a use the licence does not grant; reader.read(db=) passes it.
requirements.live_root: POST teardown upload route in app/main.py -> intake.receive (producer). Consumer is live only when a caller passes db.
requirements.remaining: no live caller passes db to library.retrieve/reader.read (teardown/proof_run.py calls reader.read without db). next_action: pass db in every live reader.read/retrieve call, and expose licence terms entry at the upload route (app/main.py, cluster E) via intake.receive(licence_terms=...).

requirements.what_changed: licence.register_public_source records public_web/public_video sources with pattern_rights='none'; Licence validation refuses any publishing use or pattern right on a public source.
requirements.remaining: no live producer registers public sources. next_action: call register_public_source from the intel observation path that records public tutorials (intel/observe.py) when source_kind is public.

requirements.what_changed: finished_item_rights and pattern_rights are separate validated columns/fields; no use in the vocabulary grants both; benchmark 2 recorded as pattern_rights=personal_use, finished_item_rights=unstated, images/text prohibited.
requirements.remaining: as F-786 (consumer live only with db).

requirements.what_changed: gateway/images._request_for (the request builder every provider call passes through) calls refuse_benchmark_references before any body is built: refuses a reference inside the benchmark library, under seller_photos/designer_photos/competitor_photos/benchmark_photos/bench1/bench2, named seller/competitor/benchmark photo, or byte-identical to a file in a BenchmarkProduct manifest (hash check when generate() has a db).
requirements.live_root: every images.generate call (visual/tournament, reference_pack, portrait_repair, publish/model_photography, owned_photography)
requirements.remaining: path/name heuristics plus manifest hashes; an unregistered competitor image with a neutral name outside those folders is not detectable by provenance alone.

requirements.what_changed: New table design_difference_ledgers (concept_key, benchmark_ref, learned, changed, why_better, independent_aspects, verdict, passed). originality.LedgerEntry/record_ledger/ledger_from_db; creative/preengineering.record persists a brief's ledger with the gate's verdict; certify requires a ledger (code-declared DECLARED_LEDGERS) when Provenance.benchmarks_consulted is non-empty (DESIGN_LEDGER_MISSING).
requirements.consumer: preengineering._redesign (reads brief or DB), originality.provenance_findings at certify
requirements.remaining: certify cannot read DB ledgers (no db) and creative CIRs only carry benchmarks_consulted from Concept.provenance 'benchmark:<ref>' lineage, not from brief['benchmarks_consulted']. next_action: creative prototype/garment_design stamp brief benchmarks into Provenance; handle_certify passes originality.ledger_from_db(ctx.db, concept_key) into certify (needs an optional ledger/db arg, cluster C).

requirements.what_changed: originality.redesign_verdict: every consulted benchmark needs an entry with learned, why_better, independent_aspects and >=2 material changes in >=2 aspects of {fit, proportions, stitch_system, shaping, construction, grading, sizing, features, finishing, silhouette}; colour/yarn/wording/size_labels/button_count/small_dimensions(<10%)/few_rows(<=4) are superficial, and a material label whose own description is superficial is demoted. New 'redesign' check (F-791) in creative/preengineering.gate_concept; NOT_APPLICABLE when no benchmark consulted.
requirements.remaining: classification is keyword/magnitude based; a determined mislabel with material vocabulary passes. Owner/analyst review of ledgers remains the backstop.

requirements.what_changed: originality.similarity_review compares a candidate against BOTH purchased benchmarks (benchmark 1 derived from cir/benchmarks CIRs; benchmark 2 Mini Star Stitch Cardigan encoded as numbers/features/construction, no wording) plus any teardown fingerprints in the DB, on wording 6-gram hashes, unusual (non-arithmetic) numeric sequences and piece-level numbers, distinctive feature combination, and construction-sequence LCS. Material overlap -> SIMILARITY_ESCALATED ERROR at certify. Wording unmeasured is reported as unmeasured, never clear. teardown/reader.read(db=) stores salted wording hashes (benchmark_fingerprints table), no text. No catalogue product escalates.
requirements.remaining: not run as a separate independent job before store.publish; DB wording fingerprints are not consulted at certify (no db); listing-presentation comparison absent; benchmark 1/2 wording fingerprints not captured (PDFs are not in the repo). next_action: cluster B enqueue a 'originality.similarity_review' job (similarity_review(cir, pattern_text, db=ctx.db)) before store.publish with escalation -> redesign card; analyst runs reader.read(..., db=db) on the purchased PDFs to capture wording.

requirements.what_changed: Licence vocabulary makes 'instruction_drafting' a prohibited use of every benchmark source; library.retrieve(db=, use='instruction_drafting') is refused.
requirements.remaining: no spec-freeze event. next_action: record originality.spec_frozen (CIR fingerprint + UTC time) before cir/writer runs for a competitor-informed product and assert no benchmark read (audit) after it.

tests_changed.why: known-good fixtures expected to certify now carry a complete Provenance; certification refuses a Brambleloop release without one
the brambleloop-authored panel-and-band fixture carries Provenance (None when authored='benchmark')
the fixture now has a provenance, so the absent case sets provenance=None explicitly; the serialisation assertion is unchanged

files_touched: src/brambleloop/creative/prototype.py (provenance stamp only; not in the explicit ownership list, owned by no cluster in audit s6 - flagged)
migrations: new tables only, created by create_all: benchmark_licences, design_difference_ledgers, benchmark_fingerprints. No column added to an existing table, so core/migrate.py needed no change.
needs_from_others: C (runtime/pipeline.py): concept_to_cir must stamp originality.catalogue_provenance (raw-geometry CIRs are now refused at certify with PROVENANCE_MISSING); handle_certify should pass db-aware inputs (ledger_from_db, DB fingerprints, licence state) - needs an optional ledger/db parameter on certify or a post-certify originality call.
B (store.publish): enqueue originality.similarity_review(cir, pattern_text, db=ctx.db) as a separate job before store.publish; escalation -> redesign card, not publish.
E (app/main.py teardown upload route): accept licence terms and pass intake.receive(licence_terms=...).

Whoever owns teardown analysis runs (teardown/proof_run.py and the analyst path): call reader.read(..., db=db) so licence use is checked and wording fingerprints are captured for the purchased benchmarks.
Creative (prototype/garment_design): carry brief['benchmarks_consulted'] into Provenance.benchmarks_consulted so certify asks for the ledger.
risks: Backfilling Provenance changes CIR.to_dict for every catalogue product, so CIR.fingerprint and the release_hash change once without any stitch changing (cir/model.py docstring warned of this; F-783 requires it). On deploy every catalogue product re-drafts/re-certifies once under new idempotency keys, derived artefacts may read STALE until rebuilt, and buyer_trust.on_certified sees a new release_hash (no orders exist; shadow).
runtime/pipeline.concept_to_cir raw-geometry CIRs now fail certify until cluster C stamps provenance.

Similarity thresholds (feature share 0.6 + construction LCS 0.7, piece-number share 0.75, wording 0.20/20 shingles) are heuristic, tuned so no catalogue product escalates and relabelled/derivative fixtures do; features/construction are read from component names.

Benchmark 2 per-size counts are encoded in src/brambleloop/gates/originality.py as the comparison set (numbers only, same precedent as cir/benchmarks.py for benchmark 1); no competitor text or image is in the repo.
Reference refusal uses path/name heuristics: a legitimate file under a directory named bench1/bench2 would be refused as a generation reference.
